hooks.text: 同时操控持剑机器人与持枪太空青蛙，把近战和远程角色合为一个操作组合。
hooks.excerpt: Simultaneously control a sword-wielding robot and a gunslinging space frog in Shoulders of Giants, an explosively colourful sci-fi roguelike designed to put your teamwork to the test.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 既可单人操控双角色，也可双人分工控制青蛙和机器人，并扩展到四人在线合作。
hooks.excerpt: Play solo, or team up with a friend, each taking control of either the frog or the robot. Battle the forces of entropy in four-player online co-op. Is your teamwork strong enough to survive?
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从抓钩到发光手雷的拾取物会显著改变能力，再通过混搭组成自定义动作套装。
hooks.excerpt: From grappling hooks to glowing grenades, each new pickup can radically alter your power and playstyle. Mix and match abilities to create a moveset that’s all your own!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: The environments can feel a bit repetitive
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 视觉呈现更护眼、容易观看

excerpts.excerpt: It's also much easier on the eyes
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 近距离射击有命中但不结算伤害的Bug。

excerpts.excerpt: there's a bug when shooting too close an enemy where the bullet hits but the damage doesn't register.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 高难度成长只是同步增加敌人生命与枪械伤害，缺少实质变化。

excerpts.excerpt: As the HEAT level increases, the mobs' HP and your gun damage simply increase. Nothing else changes.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 故事流程仅约三点五小时，内容量不足。

excerpts.excerpt: The game lasts 3.5 hours. That's the entire storyline.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 风险回报机制提供了合适挑战和奖励。

excerpts.excerpt: The risk/reward factor for saving a planet (completing a run) adds a nice challenge and indeed rewards you well
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
